snippet.text: /-- Convention: radial velocity `-r B`, angular velocity `r F`, axial velocity `U`. -/ def velocity (B F U : Profile) : VelocityField := fun w => pack (componentX B F w.1 w.2) (componentY B F w.1 w.2) (lift U w.1 w.2), with componentX B F t x = -(x 0 * lift B t x + x 1 * lift F t x), componentY B F t x = x 0 * lift F t x - x 1 * lift B t x
